**Measured directly, not inferred.** A throwaway worktree at PR #6510's head `cbb77c304` with the #6505 fix commit cherry-picked on top (`247fd634a`), running both suites:

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/validation/ \
  packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.disabledGateFaultDiagnostic.test.tsx \
  packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.validation.test.tsx

 Test Files  1 failed | 8 passed (9)
      Tests  1 failed | 157 passed (158)
```

The one failure is the predicted line, and nothing else moves:

```
FAIL  packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.disabledGateFaultDiagnostic.test.tsx
  > #6445 group 1 ... > development reports it too - one wiring, not a `__DEV__` branch
AssertionError: expected [ Array(1) ] to have a length of 2 but got 1
 ❯ .../SchemaRenderer.disabledGateFaultDiagnostic.test.tsx:372:33
    371|       expect(nonValidatorWarnings(warn)).toHaveLength(1);
    372|       expect(allWarnings(warn)).toHaveLength(2);
```

`nonValidatorWarnings(...).toHaveLength(1)` on the line above stays **green** — the by-name subtraction is invariant under the #6505 fix, exactly as its docblock intended. Only the raw-total pin moves, `2` → `1`. The other two dev cells and every production cell are green, as is `SchemaRenderer.validation.test.tsx` (the `data-obj-schema-invalid` consumer, which fires on a missing `type`, not on a gate value).

Fix is `2` → `1` on line 372, in whichever PR lands second.

**Resolved by PR #6513** (the objectui#6505 fix), which now carries the one-line change. Closing so nobody re-measures a question that has already resolved.

**It resolved in the #6505 direction.** When this was filed, PR #6510 was still in the merge queue and the fix genuinely depended on merge order. #6510 has since merged as `30c73cd25`, so #6505 is the one landing second and the adjustment is its to carry.

**Re-measured on a real merged base, not the cherry-pick simulation this issue was filed from.** `origin/main` was merged into `claude/issue-6505-predicate-valued-gate-rules` (merge, never rebase), and the suites were run **before** touching anything, over `packages/react/` and `packages/core/`:

```
Test Files  1 failed | 161 passed (162)
     Tests  1 failed | 2950 passed (2951)

FAIL  SchemaRenderer.disabledGateFaultDiagnostic.test.tsx:372
AssertionError: expected [ Array(1) ] to have a length of 2 but got 1
```

Exactly the one cell predicted here, and **no other assertion in either package moved** — so the interaction was no wider than the original measurement showed.

**What #6513 does with it**, for the record:

- `2` → `1` on that line. The pin is **not** loosened — `toHaveLength` stays, still asserting nothing else reaches the console.
- The reason is carried in a comment **at the assertion**, not only in a PR description: the second line was the `disabled must be a boolean` false positive, and objectui#6505 removed it.
- The `DEV_SCHEMA_VALIDATOR_NOISE` docblock, which stated that false positive as present-tense current behaviour, is rewritten as history in the same hunk. The by-name `nonValidatorWarnings` helper it justifies stays — every assertion using it was green throughout, which is exactly why this file needed one number changed instead of a re-audit.

Reopen if #6513 is abandoned rather than merged; the pin on `main` is correct until it lands.
